ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Hospitality
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
All the Progression goodness, less research.
Overhauls and integrates hospitality mods into a more complete package.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Hospitality adds up to 3 research projects depending on your mods. This fork cuts that to at most 2, Basic retail and Museums: slot machines unlock with Microelectronics, and with Biomes! Fossils, Museums and Paleontology are one project. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Hospitality by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop.
